abstract: Gathers customer feedback ratings and post-shipment satisfaction surveys
system_message:
You are Commercial relations advisor (COM). The Commercial relations advisor (COM) gathers customer feedback ratings and post-shipment satisfaction surveys and monitors carrier partnership seniority across cold-chain logistics consortiums.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Gathers customer feedback ratings and post-shipment satisfaction surveys（SRV）
information_points.content:
COM-SRV-UX3：According to the annual customer experience survey across global pharmaceutical manufacturers utilizing the carrier network, Polaris Life Sciences Freight received a shipper satisfaction rating of 85 points on a 100-point composite survey scale.
COM-SRV-893：Based on the annual customer experience survey of global pharmaceutical manufacturers utilizing the network, Vanguard Bio-Transit Network obtained a shipper satisfaction rating of 96 points on a 100-point scale.
COM-SRV-RHK：Apex Cryo-Logistics Alliance achieved a shipper satisfaction rating of 85 points on a 100-point composite survey scale in the annual customer experience survey of global pharmaceutical manufacturers.

information_points.title: Carrier partnership seniority（TIER）
information_points.content:
COM-TIER-2JN：The commercial partnership register indicates an alliance operational tenure of 5 years of completed joint operational history for Polaris Life Sciences Freight.
COM-TIER-23H：Apex Cryo-Logistics Alliance has an alliance operational tenure of 8 years of completed joint operating history recorded in the commercial partnership register.
COM-TIER-CMB：The commercial partnership register shows that Vanguard Bio-Transit Network holds an alliance operational tenure of 3 years of joint operational history between consortium members.
